notes.title: 1.13 Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug causing plasmas to revert to normal hamsters when caught online.
- Fixed bug causing 2nd player controls to be defaulted to keyboard. If bug is still occurring, use the 'Restore Defaults' button in the options menu for Player 2. Which should resolve the issue.

notes.title: 1.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.12

New Features:
- Emotes can now be used while in the game end animation.
- New emotes have been added to the shop.
- New plates have been added to the shop.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug causing fonts to not properly update when changing languages.
- Fixed bug causing random map select to not always select an unlocked stage.
- Hopefully fixed bug causing players to get stuck at the continue screen of online matches.
- Fixed bug causing players to not have a selector assigned when entering online character select.
- Fixed bug causing a state in which lines cannot be added to a board while playing online.
- Fixed a bug causing balls to have their sprites disabled despite being attached to the board.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.11 - March 11th
notes.content:
Version 1.11

Board Editor Bug Fixes:
- Putting invalid characters into the hamster spawn pattern field will no longer break hamster spawning.
- Repeatedly trying to place a ball in a full node will no longer cause lag.
- Removed right click to create balls as it cause various issues.
- Testing a level created by another player without editing it will no longer cause the author to change.
- File names now replaces spaces with underscores so file sharing over things like Discord won't mess up the file names.

Other Bug Fixes:
- Fixed some missing localization strings.
- Fixed a bug causing some clear stages to be failed prematurely.
- Fixed bug causing players to slide during game over sequence.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Board Editor 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Hamsters Everywhere. 🐹[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/16414177a516df203925934d7a35c72901d15e59.png[/img]

The much-awaited Board Editor update is here! Finally you can create and share your own Clear and Puzzle stages! We can't wait to see all the creative stage ideas the Hamster Scramble community comes up with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/af0389e67ef5b83a06eadb271e7d4e039b36eb14.png[/img]

[h2]New Features ⚙️ [/h2]

[list]
[*] Access via the pause menu in the Hamster Village.
[*] Create your own Clear and Puzzle stages to play and share with your friends!

[*] There is no controller support yet, so please use Keyboard & Mouse.

[*] Meter for dropping hamsters will now reduce over time when the button is released.

[list]

[*] Fixed bug causing counters to trigger when they shouldn't have when playing online.
[*] Fixed bug causing a loss to be triggered while actions on the board are still being processed.
[*] Fixed bug causing players to fall off of the banners after a match.
[/list]

notes.title: Hamster Scramble is out NOW! - Version 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Hamsters Everywhere. 🐹[/h1]

[b]The day is finally here, and Hamster Scramble is now available!! 🎉[/b]

You can finally try out all the new characters, chapters, stages, achievements, and much much more!... We've prepared a release trailer to mark the occasion!

[previewyoutube=5gjCsqOUdzs;full][/previewyoutube]

If you tried the Demo, or you are completely new to the game and decide to give it a go, we truly hope you will have a good time with all the changes and new content available! You can find the game in the link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1151100/Hamster_Scramble/

[h3]Here are some cool fixes and features we have been working on recently.[/h3]

[b]Visual Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some drifting in certain animations.
[*] Updated cutscene assets in Chapters 4-6.[/list]

[b]Audio Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stage music will now start at the countdown.
[*] Updated menu sounds.[/list]

[b]Other Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added color override options to the Color Settings menu.
[*] Increased game security via obfuscation and converting game data from XML to C# classes.
[*] Improved controller support in several menus.
[*] Fully disabled input during loading screens to prevent various bugs.
[*] Adjusted many UI elements to account for multiple languages.[/list]

[b]Networking improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Next line previews will be synced properly on clients.
[*] Dropping hamsters trigger is now handled by the local client to prevent desyncs.
[*] Popping is only riggered by the host to prevent desyncs.
[*] Characters and palettes will display properly even is the local player has not unlocked them.[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed several layering bugs.
[*] Fixed bug causing closing certain menus to overflow into lower menus.
[*] Fixed bug causing language setting to not be applied on game restart.
[*] Fixed bug causing certain scenes to not load properly when playing online.
[*] Balls will no longer get stuck on the top of the middle wall in Team Survival.[/list]

We would like to thank you all once again for all the support, the game would definitely not be the same without the amazing community we have here on Steam and on Discord! All the feedback, support messages, and even criticism all helped to shape the game so far, and rest assured: the Release is just the beginning!

And with all that said... we will see you in the woods!

[b]Best wishes,
[i]~Treasure Coast Games[/i][/b]

notes.title: Update 0.90
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Hamsters Everywhere. 🐹[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/a404adaabaf97ea9ae92c66077928b40d7b71a3b.png[/img]

Here we are again with a new update. First of all, we want to thank our players and community members for sharing their feedback. We also appreciate those brave players who took on the challenge and participated in the [b]Hamster Scramble Ranked Beta Test![/b]

[b]➝ You can see our top 3 ranked players🏅[url=https://discord.com/channels/745917211440447539/746198405339938898] [u]Here[/u] [/url][/b]

As we promised you before we will keep posting monthly development logs, and keep you in the loop of what we are working on.

This update has Networking improvements, visual changes, audio changes, bug fixes, and some other changes.

We hope you love the update as much as we do. We value your feedback and support, and we can’t wait to bring you more amazing content in the future. Thank you for being part of the Hamsters family! ❤️

Do not forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/7VmWnTaaSA] Discord [/url] so that you don't miss our upcoming events and stay up to date with the game's progress.

[b]Let’s dive in.🐹[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Visual Changes:[/h3]
[list][*] Crash Site stage assets have been updated.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/0e02dd221497f02c4ec319675a33512e882e166b.png[/img]
[h3]Audio Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed bug causing some characters audio to not play properly.[/list]
[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list][*]Improved AI traversal for certain stages.
[*]Improved AI's ability to find valid positions to throw from.
[*]Crash Site flamethrowers are no longer fully charged at the start of a round.
[*]Thrown balls will no longer bounce off the center section in the Laboratory.
[*]Added an option for the Shop to the village menu.[/list]

[h3]Networking improvements:[/h3]
[list][*]Presing continue multiple times will not skip checking if other players are ready.
[*]Player 4 now works in private rooms.
[*]Players will no longer be stopped mid-way through a shift if a game ends.
[*]Matchmaking will no longer attempt to enter an in-process ranked match if one player disconnects.
[*]Team and Counter drop combos should register more consistently.
[*]Board syncing is overall improved and much more consistent.
[*]Hamster Spawn Max is now counted properly so players cannot spawn unlimited hamsters by [*]repeatedly picking up and dropping hamsters on their side.[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed bug causing arrows in story mode character select to not work.
[*]Fixed bug causing Gail's attack animation to play too quickly.
[*]Fixed bug causing an additional AI opponent to spawn when retrying a Versus stage in story mode.
[*]Fixed bug causing certain UI in stages to not show/hide properly.
[*]Fixed bug causing music tracks to not have correct names and sometimes be unable to purchase.
[*]Hitting max rank will no longer cause the rank up animation to freeze.
[*]Fixed bug allowing some characters to drop hamsters out of bounds of the stage.
[*]Fixed bug causing the bottom right most node to not be considered properly when a ball connects to the puzzle board.
[*]Singleplayer cutscenes will no longer persist into local or online versus matches.[/list]

notes.title: Demo is Live
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Hamsters Everywhere. 🐹[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/a820ea49d473c87bc2bd60f702cbc723d70b451b.png[/img]
Welcome to the very first patch notes for [b]Hamster Scramble[/b]! 
Time went frighteningly fast, but only because we had been very busy. We wanted to take the opportunity to share some progress with you all before our memories blur. We will try to keep up with monthly development logs, as it’s a good way to track our progress and keep you all in the loop.

This update has bug fixes, mechanics, visuals, and other changes we have been working on.

We know we’ve been a bit quiet about sharing our progress lately, but it’s only because we’ve been working towards finalizing the game.

➝ Do not forget to join us on [url=https://discord.gg/Pjfasd5PAt]Discord[/url] so that you can keep up to date with the game progress and have some cool hamster wallpapers.

[url=https://discord.gg/Pjfasd5PAt][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/5c5806048eb671167da2ab85be6f28aa1c22f519.png[/img][/url]

Without any further ado, let’s jump in. 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Mechanic Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added super attacks to battles against certain characters in the story.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/3d0dc8763515c35b4bd3d93bc99e089a467b9899.gif[/img]
[*]Players can now drop held hamsters by holding the attack button.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/6a3f5eec46964af372f23cccae9f3b09e43cde55.gif[/img]
[*]Adjusted the layout of the Airship stage to make traversal easier.
[/list]
[h2]Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]New assets for Seren Woods stage[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/5c051478d38d4a0f0fd8926b7b5a962ce9093378.png[/img][*]New assets for Bolor Mountain stage[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/3be5e40fc26729a0de2d515fdc93167c6915266c.png[/img][*]New menu UI assets for stage results and online menus.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/1434f093ade6bf4927da3b7b1da41688e6d45f51.png[/img][*]Updated and improved Hamster Village art assets.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/fc74fa8890c4fdf075bf4945198ac93f63897e3b.png[/img]
[*]New assets for story intro scenes.
[*]New loading screen assets.
[*]New assets for stage select menu.
[*]New assets for win/lose banners.
[*]Improved hamster dialogue boxes in the Hamster Village.
[*]Added and adjusted many new palettes for all characters.
[*]Hamster balls now slide into position when connecting to the board rather than snapping.
[*]Added new text and particle effects to story cutscenes.
[*]Updated cutscene sprites for all characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/f90902401285d62f199104e13fc6648d968c7c12.png[/img]
[*]New animations for Bank Shot, MultiMatch, Team Combo/Drop, and Counter Match/Drop.
[*]Updated game logo on Title Screen.
[*]Adjusted the timer position in Survival and Team Survival so it can always be viewed.
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new sequence to the story introduction section.
[*]Updated and added sound effects for player actions, cutscenes, and UI.
[*]Updated hamster dialogue in the Hamster Village.
[*]Added ability to skip story opening scene.
[*]Chinese, Japanese, and Korean language support (incomplete).
[*]Improved mouse support in menus.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue causing players to get stuck against the wall in the Airship stage.
[*]Fixed issue causing some boss AI's to get stuck in a certain action.
[*]Fixed a bug causing hamsters to occasionally get stuck on the upper corner of spawners.
[*]Fixed many issues and bugs in story cutscenes.
[*]Various fixes and updates to improve network play.
[*]Fixed issue causing the catch action to cause certain platforms to react rapidly to the player landing on them.
[*]Fixed a bug causing a soft lock in the story select menu when attempting to access a locked chapter.
[*]Made it less likely for hamsters to get caught up on collision boxes while traversing pipes.
[*]Fixed bugs in certain UI elements regarding locked palettes and characters.
[*]Fixed bugs causing hamsters to get caught and fall out of the stage when pausing during tutorial cutscenes.
[*]Fixed bug causing AI to not find opponents when swapped.
[*]Fixed a bug in the Options Menu when rapidly turning pages that broke the navigation.
[/list]

notes.title: Closed Beta Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/63cb512e6bd48daa1bceb626f51e197adf0f1269.jpg[/img]

Hamster Scramble is finally headed into closed beta! Available [b]right now[/b] through the official Hamster Scramble discord! 

[b]This initial closed beta will run from August 11th at 7:00 am PST to August 18th at 7:00 am PST[/b]

The last time Hamster Scramble was available to play was last years PAX Online. This time around there are tons of new features to explore! The beta will include:
[list]
[*] Local versus play
[*] Online versus play
[*] Online profile customization
[*] The first 3 chapters of the story mode
[*] A shop to buy character palettes, stages, music, and more!
[/list]

So hop on into the Hamster Scramble discord to request your beta key and get scrambling!

[url=http://invite.gg/hamscram][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35958399/5c5806048eb671167da2ab85be6f28aa1c22f519.png[/img][/url]
